notes.title: Fixed the image files loading error(updated to ver2.11)
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting.

Fixed a bug that the image files could not be read.

This update is a mechanism to rewrite the contents of the savedata at the time of loading, so it will be automatically corrected if you load the previous save.
(You can now play with save data files before 2.10 too.)

If stable startup is possible, in the next update, add Takeda and Liberty as 'deleted scenes'.
